Aisha (CS Lead): Heads up — Acme Corp EBR / boardroom readiness sprint kickoff. We have a 20-min exec slot next Tue. Need slide polish, renewal signal snapshot, and a 2-min ROI ask.
Tom (AE): Got it. I can own the renewal signal slide and exec notes. Will pull ARR / NPS datapoints. @Priya can you confirm onboarding completion status? :eyes:
Priya (CS): Quick update — onboarding is 95% done. Remaining: SSO + a small data mapping task (ETA Thu). I'll add a short "risks and mitigations" bullet.
Sam (Eng): Demo readiness: I can rehearse the live flow but we should include a pre-recorded fallback clip. Ops gives flaky data for the mapping edge case.
Cara (RevOps): I'll prepare the health dashboard snapshot and a concise renewal-impact chart. Where should I drop the PNG? Drive or Confluence?
Aisha (CS Lead): Drive link is fine. Put in the folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/Acme-EBR-2026 — use naming: slide_##_owner.png.
Tom (AE): Renewal signal plan: 3 slides — 1) engagement & usage trends 2) risk drivers 3) proposed exec ask. I'll draft by Wed EOD.
Priya (CS): I'll write the "onboarding closure + open items" slide. Short bullets, include owners and dates.
Sam (Eng): For the demo slide, add a fallback clip link + a 1-line note: "If live fails, play clip at 00:35". I'll upload the clip to Drive.
Aisha (CS Lead): Action items (quick list):
```
- Tom: draft renewal signal  slides (Due: Wed EOD)
- Priya: onboarding closure slide + mitigations (Due: Thu 10am PT)
- Sam: demo fallback clip + note (Due: Thu 12pm PT)
- Cara: health dashboard PNG + slide (Due: Wed 5pm PT)
- Aisha: consolidate slides and run 30-min dry run on Fri
```
Tom (AE): Can someone add a 1-slide "ask" one-liner for execs? I can write copy but need a single-sentence endorsement from leadership.
Aisha (CS Lead): I'll loop in Exec Sponsor after dry run. For now put a placeholder: "Ask: Approve 12-month renewal at 10% discount to secure roadmap priority".
OpsBot: Reminder: Meeting room reserved Tue 09:00 PT — Boardroom A, AV check scheduled 08:30.
Priya (CS): Also capture feedback themes from the CS health survey — 3 bullets max: onboarding docs clarity, API latency, billing cadence. I'll surface verbatim quotes in appendix.
Cara (RevOps): FYI — renewal contract draft w/ legal is in progress. If we push discount, revenue ops need 72hr lead to update entitlements.
Sam (Eng): One ask for product: can we highlight the new low-latency rollout in the "value delivered" slide? Small perf numbers look good.
Aisha (CS Lead): Great. Plan: Wed 11am PT check-in for slide turns, Fri 2pm PT dry run (30m). Please mark calendar. If someone can't make dry run, upload notes.
Tom (AE): Marked. Will upload my draft to Drive by Wed EOD and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): Noted. I'll add the mitigation owners inline and ping infra for the mapping ETA.
Cara (RevOps): Uploading dashboard PNG now. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/Acme-EBR-2026/dashboard_v1.png
Aisha (CS Lead): Closing note: this thread is the single source for slide ownership. No off-thread edits unless reflected here. Thanks team — we'll aim to keep exec time crisp. :rocket:
